title: Very disappointed
text: After seeing the pics posted with chakra stones, bracelets, and other ‘healing’ items, I decided to give it a go & signed up for the premium box. Received Januarys, and it was little more than some small packages of face masks, lotions, and gels. More like what a teenager would want. At my age, I’ve got my skin care routine down. Canceled in disappointment.
label: negative
